text:
alex: Heads-up — scheduling a rolling maintenance for phoenix-pool tonight 02:00-05:00 UTC. Scope: NIC firmware update + thermal/fan-curve tuning. Expect soft drains + reboots per rack; approximate capacity reduction 15–20% while each rack is being rotated. Canary: rack-px-01 and rack-px-02 first. Plan is drain -> reboot -> KV-cache reseed -> warmbackfill. Notifying oncall and status page.

jin: ACK. Can you post the exact ops play and the canary/abort criteria?

alex: Canary success criteria: <0.5% 5m error spike, P95 latency shift <+50ms, zero pod evictions for stateful jobs. If canary fails we rollback NIC fw on those racks and stop the roll. Minor regressions -> extend warmbackfill and monitor. Canary scheduled 02:15 UTC.

priya: Cost question — if we need cross-region backfill can we budget extras? Estimate if we spin up 3 extra GPUs in eu-west1 for ~3h that's ~1.2k USD. Can ops cover?

sam: On autoscaler: I'll bump cluster-autoscaler max nodes +3 and set scale-down delay to 20m for the window. Also suggest applying a temporary "no-preempt" label for priority pods.

lina: I'll draft customer comms. Short message on status.redwood.com + email to reserved customers. We should call out: "latency may increase briefly during handoffs" and "no data-plane schema changes".

ops-bot: [scheduled maintenance created] ID: maint-2026-176767. Window: 2026-04-12 02:00-05:00 UTC. Channel: #phoenix-maint. Ping: @oncall.

alex: Preflight checklist (~90m before):
```bash
# verify pool nodes
kubectl get nodes -l pool=phoenix-pool
# kvseed verification
curl -s https://internal-admin/kvseed/phoenix | jq .
# cordon/drain (soft)
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```

jin: I'll run kvseed verification and add a lightweight replay probe to run after warmbackfill.

priya: Approving cost cover. Please tag invoices to "ops-maint-thermal-2026" so Finance can track.

sam: Autoscaler patch ready, pushing in 15m. Reminder: do not allow more than +3 concurrent racks upgraded.

lina: Draft posted to #customer-comms: https://docs.internal/drafts/phoenix-maint. Scheduled email queued for dedicated customers.

alex: Operational timeline (UTC):
- 01:00 prechecks + kvseed
- 01:30 canary prep
- 02:00 start canary rack px-01
- 02:15 verify canary metrics
- 02:30 proceed with batch of 3 racks, stagger 20m per rack
- 04:40 final backfills + verify
- 05:00 close window

jin: Add a step to monitor model-serving request queues and fail fast if any request drop >0.1% for 5m. I'll set a temporary pager at that threshold.

lina: I'll update the status page live notes and include: "If you see production errors escalate, contact oncall@redwood.com".

sam: Also patch router fallback: if phoenix avg latency >200ms route to eu-west1 variant. I'm on it.

alex: @oncall please ack once you're ready to be paged and update #phoenix-maint at start-of-window.

oncall-scheduler: oncall assigned: priya for 02:00–06:00. Priya, you have pager duty.

priya: ACK — I'll be online and monitoring dashboards. :thumbsup:

alex: Final ops note — do not upgrade >3 racks concurrently. If we see sustained errors +10% abort and rollback NIC fw. :warning:

ops-bot: [maintenance started] maint-2026-176767 px-01 reboot started at 02:05 UTC.

jin: Canary metrics so far look good. p95 +12ms, errors 0.12%. Proceeding with next batch.

lina: Customers notified. Email sent to reserved customers. :envelope_with_arrow:

priya: Oncall confirms no critical pages so far, continuing to monitor.

alex: Thanks team. I'll drop the postmortem template here after close: https://docs.internal/postmortems/phoenix-maint-template

alex: Quick reminder — capture KV-cache hit rate and token cost delta in the postmortem (important for Optimize team).

priya: Will capture metrics and collect logs.

sam: After window I'll revert autoscaler max back to pre-window values in 1h if stable.

ops-bot: [maintenance complete] maint-2026-176767 closed at 05:02 UTC. Summary: canary OK, rolled through 9 racks, transient p95 bump observed, no evictions. Postmortem draft incoming.
